note: Sac County Conservation park 1.5 mi south of Early on US 71/20. The seven shaded rock pads sit on a small loop just west of the highway, with an enclosed shelterhouse, playground and a small pond nearby; the western two-thirds of the park, across the Boyer River (creek-sized here, about 275 m west of the loop), is a wildlife area. Firearm hunting is allowed in the park after the campground closes in mid-October. --Claude
summary: The county's mycountyparks pages confirm 7 shaded first-come sites with water and electric (to 50A), $25 modern / $15 tent / $150 weekly, open May 1 to mid-October. Phone 712-662-4530 found. Not waterfront stands (Boyer is creek-sized and ~275 m off); pin is on the US 71 shoulder ~95 m from the loop.

BOOKING WORDING CONFLICT: the park page says twice 'first-come, first-served, NO RESERVATIONS', but the campground facility page's season line reads 'Opens May 1st (reservation only)' with 'Call for Availability'. The park page's explicit statement was used; there is no bookable campsite on mycountyparks for it.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed. On NAIP the pads (~42.4399,-95.1490) line a small loop in a spruce/hardwood block beside US 71; the Boyer River meanders about 275 m west through plantings and is roughly 8-12 m wide (creek-sized, under the ~30 m line). The park's 'small pond' (~50 x 40 m on imagery, well under 5 acres) is south of the loop.
